summary: Disclose mission rows that cannot be shown because their data does not match the expected format

replay.detail: No daemon replay or persistent recovery changes.

schema.detail: Web-only presentation of existing SDK decode evidence. AgentId and generated schemas remain strict and unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade.

compatibility.detail: Valid missions remain visible alongside a counted notice for rejected rows. All-bad frames retain last-good missions as stale. The server payload correction is independent.

downtime.detail: No expected interruption or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator action or configuration change is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or rollback restrictions; a valid subsequent observation clears the notice.
